open_points.subject: AdmissionVerdict actor
open_points.text: State 0 says the kernel's records “name it as the actor” for automatic admission, but M27 says “AdmissionVerdict ... names no actor”.
open_points.question: Does every AdmissionVerdict record the kernel as its deciding actor, or is admission exempt from the requirement that automatic decisions name the kernel?
options: Add a kernel actor fact to AdmissionVerdict
Keep AdmissionVerdict actorless and make automatic admission an explicit exception

open_points.subject: TrialExecution actor
open_points.text: The action “try an implementation” may be performed by any agent, but M07 records no initiating actor, and M27 says the causing request is told by “the implementation's submitted_by”.
open_points.question: How does a TrialExecution identify the agent who requested that trial when that agent differs from the agent who submitted the implementation, and distinguish such a trial from executions created by automatic admission?
options: Record the requesting agent or kernel on each TrialExecution
Link TrialExecutions to a separate trial/admission invocation record carrying the actor
Treat all TrialExecutions as kernel actions and do not retain the requesting agent
open_points.default_guess: Record requested_by on TrialExecution, using the requesting agent for an explicit trial and kernel for admission executions.
